sents.t: Because if they catch even a glimpse of you...
sents.zh: 因为就算他们只瞄了你一眼...

sents.t: You think they come around to meet new friends, huh?
sents.zh: 你觉得他们是出海来结交新朋友的吗

sents.t: So, I'm just making sure you know
we'd go weeks without seeing a boat
sents.zh: 好几周都看不到一支船

sents.t: Just a sweaty land monster with a paddle
sents.zh: 只有一个划着桨 汗流浃背的陆怪

sents.t: here's a champion show crab if I ever saw one
sents.zh: 这是我见过的最顶级的赛级蟹了

sents.t: Don't look her in the eye!
We better beat those Branzinos at the crab show this year
sents.zh: 我们最好在今年的螃蟹秀上打败那帮布兰奇鲈

sents.t: Everyone thinks Bianca Branzino's so great
sents.zh: 所有人都觉得比安卡·布兰奇鲈很厉害

sents.t: with her prize-winning crabs and amazing dolphin impression
sents.zh: 因为她有只奖杯收割机螃蟹 还很会模仿海豚

cards.ex: A glimpse is a very quick look at something. You see it for only a second.
exs: I only caught a glimpse of the sea monster before it swam away.
cards.note: Day 1 原句：“Because if they catch even a glimpse of you...”（因为就算他们只瞄了你一眼...）

cards.ex: Come around means to come to a place, often a place near you.
exs: The fishermen come around the island every morning.
cards.note: Day 1 原句：“You think they come around to meet new friends, huh?”（你觉得他们是出海来结交新朋友的吗）

cards.ex: Sweaty means wet with sweat. Your body gets sweaty when you are hot or work hard.
exs: After rowing the boat all day, he was tired and sweaty.
cards.note: Day 1 原句：“Just a sweaty land monster with a paddle”（只有一个划着桨 汗流浃背的陆怪）

cards.ex: Molting means an animal is losing its old shell, skin, or feathers so a new one can grow.
exs: The crab is molting, so its new shell is still soft.
cards.note: Day 1 原句：“She's molting”（她在换壳）

cards.ex: Magnificent means very beautiful or very great. It makes you say “wow!”
exs: The sunset over the sea was magnificent.
cards.note: Day 1 原句：“Oh, it's magnificent”（真是太神奇了）

cards.ex: Ever means at any time. We often use it in questions and in “if I ever …”.
exs: Have you ever seen a crab this big?
cards.note: Day 1 原句：“here's a champion show crab if I ever saw one”（这是我见过的最顶级的赛级蟹了）

cards.ex: A champion is the winner of a contest. A champion is the best one.
exs: Her crab won first prize. It is the champion of the show.
cards.note: Day 1 原句：“here's a champion show crab if I ever saw one”（这是我见过的最顶级的赛级蟹了）

cards.ex: Apologize means to say “I’m sorry” because you did something wrong.
exs: Luca was late, so he apologized to his mom.
cards.note: Day 1 原句：“But don't apologize”（但也别道歉啊）

cards.ex: Beat means to win against someone in a game or contest.
exs: Our team wants to beat the other team this year.
cards.note: Day 1 原句：“We better beat those Branzinos at the crab show this year”（我们最好在今年的螃蟹秀上打败那帮布兰奇鲈）

cards.ex: An impression is when you copy the sound or the way a person or animal acts, often to be funny.
exs: She does a great dolphin impression. She sounds just like a real dolphin!
cards.note: Day 1 原句：“with her prize-winning crabs and amazing dolphin impression”（因为她有只奖杯收割机螃蟹 还很会模仿海豚）
